title: Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: one letter of the documented prefix changes (sk-ant-admim01-) (basis: provider) and prefix: sk-ant-admin01- becomes sk-ant-admin01_ (only the separator after the version changes) (basis: provider). Twin of "Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
